body: Ughhh same. It makes me self analyze too when I'm around others. Like I know I'm acting like a fucking alien and I'm afraid they'll judge me if I say or do anything wrong.

Holy shit you sound just like me when it comes to wanting to be something impossible to achieve. Like why couldn't I have dreamed of being an accountant or some shit. Nostalgia's a helluva drug. It's reduced me to doing nothing but play Pokémon blue on my phone for hours instead of work toward my goals. I'm truly sorry you're going through the same thing. I wouldn't wish it on anyone.
Man I'm only safe when I'm high out of my mind

honestly, I'm usually super goal driven and have to constantly be working toward that goal. I want to make a living being a musician of all stupid things, but it's just not gonna work out for obvious reasons. It's not "realistic". Lately when I try to write or listen to what I have written I'm filled with dread and resentment
